definition: Direct reconstructed metric near-zone response with unit gravitational source and zero independent electromagnetic source. The independently recovered static response fixes the zero-frequency constant; no Schwarzschild subtraction is applied.
polar_love_normalization: k20_polar=-(C_response/C_source)/M^5 in the metric convention used here
controlled_range: Momega <= 0.006; 0.006 is the edge diagnostic and carries the largest matching-window uncertainty.
